name: 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion: SPY Peak & Drawdown Analysis
description: Analyzes each 2s/10s yield curve inversion event (T10Y2Y crosses below 0). For each inversion, tracks the subsequent SPY peak, the lag in calendar days from inversion start to that peak, and the maximum drawdown from peak. Includes inversion regime bands on SPY price chart, the spread with zero-line reference, event markers at each inversion crossing, and a per-event summary table with key metrics.
source:
# --- 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion → SPY Peak & Drawdown Analysis ---
# Detects each inversion (T10Y2Y < 0), finds the subsequent SPY peak,
# measures lag from inversion start to peak, and max drawdown from peak.

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
spy = src.c
ts = index().value

# 2s/10s spread from FRED (forward-filled for weekends/holidays)
spread_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="T10Y2Y")
spread = ffill(spread_raw.result)

# --- Inversion Detection ---
# Inversion starts when spread crosses below zero
inv_start = crossunder(spread, 0)

# Inversion regime: active while spread < 0
in_inversion = hold_until(spread < 0, spread >= 0)

# Inversion ends when spread crosses back above zero
inv_end = crossover(spread, 0)

# --- Metrics at Inversion Start ---
# Latch SPY price and timestamp at each inversion start
spy_at_inv_start = valuewhen(inv_start, spy, 0)
ts_at_inv_start = valuewhen(inv_start, ts, 0)

# --- SPY Peak During Inversion ---
# Running max of SPY (large window covers full inversion, typically < 3 years)
spy_running_max = agg(spy, 756, AggregationType.Max)

# At inversion end, capture the peak that occurred during the inversion
spy_peak_at_end = valuewhen(inv_end, spy_running_max, 0)

# --- Lag: Calendar Days from Inversion Start to Inversion End ---
# This measures the full inversion duration
inv_duration = datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.days)(ts_at_inv_start, ts)
inv_duration_at_end = where(inv_end, inv_duration)

# --- SPY Performance During Inversion ---
spy_at_end = valuewhen(inv_end, spy, 0)
spy_return_during = where(inv_end, (spy_at_end - spy_at_inv_start) / spy_at_inv_start)

# --- Max Drawdown from Peak (post-inversion) ---
# After the peak, how far did SPY fall? Measure drawdown at inversion end
dd_at_end = where(inv_end, (spy_at_end - spy_peak_at_end) / spy_peak_at_end)

# --- Spread level at inversion start ---
spread_at_start = valuewhen(inv_start, spread, 0)
spread_at_start_emit = where(inv_end, spread_at_start)

# SPY at start, emitted at inversion end
spy_start_emit = where(inv_end, spy_at_inv_start)

# SPY peak, emitted at inversion end
spy_peak_emit = where(inv_end, spy_peak_at_end)

# --- Event Markers: Inversion Start ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Yield Curve Inversion',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='2s/10s Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(spread, spy, inv_start)

# --- Chart 1: SPY Price with Inversion Regime Bands ---
inv_band = nz(in_inversion, 0)

xy_lines(
    title='SPY Price During Yield Curve Inversions',
    y_axis_label='SPY Price ($)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    category='Yield Curve Inversion',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Inverted', color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, spy, inv_band)

# --- Chart 2: 2s/10s Spread with Zero Line ---
xy_lines(
    title='When Does the Curve Invert?',
    y_axis_label='2s/10s Spread (%)',
    category='Yield Curve Inversion',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='T10Y2Y', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-3, to=0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label='Inverted')
    ]),
    order=2
)(ts, spread)

# --- Summary Table: Per-Inversion Event Detail ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Yield Curve Inversion',
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='What Happens After Each Inversion?',
        row_size=1, col_size=5,
        col_headers=['Spread at Entry', 'SPY at Entry', 'SPY Peak', 'Duration (Days)', 'SPY Return'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(spread_at_start_emit, spy_start_emit, spy_peak_emit, inv_duration_at_end, spy_return_during)
